---
title: "HTML output mistaken for bslib output (issue #15023)"
format: dashboard
_quarto:
  tests:
    dashboard:
      ensureHtmlElements:
        -
          - ".card.cell .test-subslide"
          - ".card.cell .test-name"
          - ".test-lifted"
        -
          - ".card.cell .test-lifted"
---

Regression test for #15023. The dashboard filter lifts a cell's raw HTML
output out of its card when it takes the output for bslib components,
which it detected with the Lua pattern `'bslib-'`. In a Lua pattern `-` is
a quantifier, so that pattern matched any text containing `bsli`: the word
"subslide", or the name `bslib` without a hyphen. Such output left its
card, and a card with nothing else in it was dropped, title and all.

The first two cells hold text like that and must keep their output in
their card. The third holds a `bslib-` class, as real bslib components do,
and must still be lifted out of the card. The selectors name `.card.cell`,
the card built from a cell: when every output is lifted, the dashboard
wraps what is left of the page, these outputs included, in a card of its
own, which carries no `.cell` class.

```{python}
#| title: A word
from IPython.display import HTML
HTML('<p class="test-subslide">A subslide of the deck</p>')
```

```{python}
#| title: A name without a hyphen
HTML('<p class="test-name">Cards are built by bslib</p>')
```

```{python}
#| title: A bslib component
HTML('<div class="bslib-mock test-lifted">Component</div>')
```
